0022600005.text: Both the Los Angeles Lakers and Golden State Warriors open their 2026-27 seasons, with the Lakers hosting. The Lakers won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 119-103 win in San Francisco on April 9, 2026. The Warriors are missing Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (undisclosed), and Moses Moody (knee, surgery), while ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Lakers a 65% chance to win.
